explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/838, second question: does there exist a constant c with lim log f(n)/(log n)² = c, where f(n) is the least number of convex subsets determined by n points in ℝ² with no three collinear? The Lean statement ∃ c : ℝ, log(f n)/(log n)² → c, with f n the minimum count of convex-position subsets (including ∅, singletons and pairs, a polynomial shift that does not affect log f(n)/(log n)², given f(n) ≥ n^{c₁ log n}). Real-valued c matches the source (Erdős's bounds force 0 < c < ∞ if it exists). Faithful (positive form of the yes/no question).
